verses.text: The LORD reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits on his throne among the cherubim. Let the earth shake.
The LORD is great in Zion. He stands high above every people.
Let them praise your great name, the name that fills them with awe. He is holy!
The mighty King loves justice. You make things fair. You do what’s just and right in Jacob.
Lift up the LORD our God. Bow down at his footstool. He is holy!
Moses and Aaron served among his priests, and Samuel was among those who called on his name. They called to the LORD, and he answered them.
He spoke to them from the pillar of cloud. They kept his teachings and the law he gave them.
You answered them, LORD our God. You forgave them, even as you held them accountable for what they did.
Lift up the LORD our God. Worship at his holy hill, because the LORD our God is holy!
